title: India's Only Floating Post Office on Dal Lake Extends Hours
excerpt: The houseboat post office at Nehru Park in Srinagar will now open from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m., up from five hours, after heavy footfall and demand for services beyond regular hours.
body:
SRINAGAR — India's only floating post office, operating from a houseboat on Dal Lake in Srinagar, will now stay open for 12 hours a day, from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m., the Department of Posts has announced.

The working hours have been extended from five hours to 12 hours, Jammu News Portal reported on Friday, citing the department's announcement. The post office is located at Nehru Park on Dal Lake and is managed by India Post.

  • Dal Lake's floating post office will now remain open from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. — 12 hours a day, up from five hours.
  • The Department of Posts cited heavy footfall at Nehru Park and public demand for postal services beyond regular office hours.
  • The move follows a similar extension at Srinagar's Lal Chowk Head Post Office, which also now operates from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m.
  • Officials said extending timings at more post offices in the region is also being explored.

The decision was taken after a visit to the facility by Sagar Hanuman Singh, chief postmaster general for Jammu, Kashmir and Ladakh, who reviewed the facilities and interacted with customers and tourists to assess their requirements, The JK Post reported. He was accompanied by Director Postal Services Prateek and Senior Superintendent of Post Offices for the Srinagar Postal Division, Adam Mohi U Din.

Taking note of the heavy footfall at Nehru Park and demand for services beyond regular office hours, the department decided to extend the timings, the reports said. Singh said the move aims to provide greater convenience to tourists, local residents and other visitors. Prateek described the floating post office as both an important postal facility and a major tourist attraction.

The floating post office provides regular postal services to residents and tourists while offering visitors the unusual experience of using a post office from a houseboat on Dal Lake, The JK Post reported. That dual role — a working branch for people who live and work on and around the lake, and a stop on the tourist circuit at Nehru Park — is what makes longer hours practical: demand does not end when a conventional office would close, because visitors are still on the water and residents still need to send and receive mail.

The extension also follows a pattern the department has already tested in Srinagar. Adam Mohi U Din said the encouraging public response to extended working hours at the Lal Chowk Head Post Office — which also now operates from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. — prompted the department to improve access at the floating post office as well. He added that the possibility of extending timings at more post offices in the region is also being explored.

For visitors, the change is simple and useful: a postcard, parcel or other postal business at Dal Lake no longer has to be squeezed into a short morning-to-afternoon window. For the department, the floating post office remains a small facility with an outsized profile — described in both reports as India's only floating post office — and keeping it open into the evening aligns its hours with the rhythm of the lake it serves.
image_caption: Dal Lake in Srinagar, home to India's only floating post office at Nehru Park. The post office has extended its working hours to 9 a.m. to 9 p.m.
nri_angle: Dal Lake's floating post office is a familiar Srinagar landmark for Kashmiri diaspora families and for diaspora travellers visiting Kashmir, many of whom use it to send postcards and parcels during trips home.
author: Diaspora Desk
